countries.reasoning: China is the dominant producer of gallium arsenide primarily through its large Ga and GaAs semiconductor material manufacturing, based on USGS and industry reports from 2023. Data reliability is high due to comprehensive national production statistics.

Germany is a major producer within the EU with advanced semiconductor industry participation. Data derived from European semiconductor manufacturing reports and estimated USGS data suggests stable production figures.
The US has significant gallium arsenide production tied to military and commercial semiconductor sectors. US Geological Survey data and solid reporting from industry sources confirm production scale.

South Korean semiconductor industry contributes notably to gallium arsenide production. Estimates based on company disclosures and regional trade data; less formal national statistics reduce confidence slightly.

Japan has established semiconductor manufacturing capacity with associated GaAs production. Reports from Japanese industry sources and trade data exist but are less centralized, slightly reducing confidence.
